name: Connect your booking calendar (Cal.com or Calendly)
objective: Guide a non-technical business owner to create an API key for their booking tool so a robot can manage bookings and reminders. Default to Cal.com: from app.cal.com, sign in, open Settings then Developer then API Keys, create a new key, and reveal it ready to copy. If they use Calendly instead, adapt and guide them through calendly.com integrations to generate a personal access token. Read the live screen each step and adapt to whatever the app currently shows.
successCriteria: A booking-tool API key or personal access token is revealed on screen ready to copy. Treat the task as complete once it is visible.
notes: Never read or repeat the key's characters. The human performs every click and keystroke; only point and explain.
finishLine: This key lets your robot see and manage your bookings — nothing else.
